projects.title: Emergency Hospital Accessability Map
keywords: WebGIS, QGIS, Urban planning, Network analysis, Javascript, CSS, HTML, Leaflet
projects.description: An interactable web map of the accessibility to emergency hospitals in Stockholm County. The map is meant to create an overview of areas with weaker levels of access in the county, including population data to allow users to better understand & analyse how the population is impacted. The map has is based on a network analysis that uses road data from Trafikverket, a population grid from SCB, emergency hospital points from QuickOSM, and the county border from SCB. The project was a great way to reinforce the network analysis, and a fun way to explore webGIS with some programming languages and a commonly used library in Leaflet. There is a full documentation of the methods and data used available as a PDF.
